conclusion: No blocking issue found in the reviewed unsealed collector and actual-value sealer.

historical_normal_protocol.scope: R29 normal lifecycle field/schema/round reference only; its reserve/saturation and larger XZ bounds were not reused

checks.syntax: Both final Python files parsed with ast.parse, without importing or executing them.
checks.safe_collection: Original nested file/directory traversal, canonical path/no-follow checks, regular single-link requirements, before/open/after stamps, bounded reads and private-key/ELF/credential exclusions remain unchanged. Fixed FROZEN fixture root is an explicit mapping, not a broad directory scan.
checks.selection: Three lifecycle result directories may be absent after failure. Fixed installed tools remain required. Core result files are collected when present; original holder terminal and complete stored read pages are mandatory. Absence is captured as current namespace state, not fabricated execution success.
checks.static_pins: 71 pins: 59 retained entries are identical to the previously reviewed OBS collector, including all three installed lifecycle-derived tool pins. Twelve added entries cover actual OBS prerequisites, actual LC input and six frozen-job originals. No prior static pin was silently changed.
checks.false_and_partial: Parent, normal report, round index, gates, descriptive summary, original tool tests and monitor reports are optional parsed objects. Raw malformed JSON is retained and reported as a binding/interpretation limitation. Ordered stage prefixes and nonzero returns do not by themselves prevent failure evidence retention. Missing rounds/counters remain unavailable rather than invented.
checks.complete_normal_protocol: References the actual two-stage R35 parent and original ABBA order with ten normal-stage names, four round identities and eleven phase-file names per declared round. Actual per-round counters come from retained original audits; historical counts are not substituted.
checks.positive_branch: Only a parent that reports success enters the complete-positive requirements. It still requires original native/holder custody, all 14 tool tests, complete normal ABBA and gates, source/input closure, observation prerequisite and monitor closure. In particular, the original positive-only observation_gate_verified check is retained despite its absence in this failed attempt.
checks.native_streams: Original terminal accepts completed failed/cancelled/timed-out states. Pages must start at zero and exactly cover final stored bytes, with byte/text/cursor/EOF agreement. Positive custody additionally needs all native completeness/durability/log fields and seen==stored. Failed originals keep their actual fields.
checks.final_minor_delta: Compared with the first-reviewed 57,271-byte draft, only summary changes: optional materializer pair terminal/stream display, plus clearly labeled derived lists of false flags already present in original gate comparisons. The other 14 functions are byte-identical. No threshold or performance metric is recomputed.
checks.sealer: Reads bounded stable local original bodies and identity-bearing metadata; validates fixed selected path mapping, static-pin equality on overlaps and duplicate-identity agreement. Requires original holder terminal/read; optional reports may be absent or have retained parse errors. It derives actual nullable outcomes/counts from original documents and changes only the ACTUAL assignment under AST equality.
checks.no_future_success: Unsealed ACTUAL is None and collect/summary/create/verify reject before source collection or archive use. No known Q/OBS success is treated as normal-LC success. Collector and sealer never adopt the candidate.
checks.output: Exactly lifecycle-evidence-01.tar.gz/.manifest.json/.compact.json, create-only O_EXCL and no-follow. Combined final archive/sidecar bytes are bounded at64MiB. Construction uses memory buffers, not temporary extraction directories; a write failure preserves partial create-only output and does not overwrite/retry it.
checks.verify: Retains bounded compressed/archive/member parsing, per-member SHA/length and summary comparison. Reads in memory without extraction or execution of archived programs.

scope_limits: This is source/AST/hash review, not an execution of the collector, sealer, verifier, original auditors, tools, fixtures, tests or benchmarks.
The actual seal must still bind the original holder job and the supplied real reports. This review does not assert an archive was created or that all remote selected files currently match.

The 59 inherited static pins and explicit added identities were compared to prior reviewed evidence and current original references; this review does not claim a new independent read of all71 remote bodies. The future collector re-reads and verifies every selected required file.
Full Mac holder log bodies are not claimed to be copied into the x230 archive; their identities remain in the original full holder report.
Receipt binding errors are reported separately from original operation/gate outcomes. A completed workflow or successfully created archive is not performance acceptance.
Source/ELF/profile bodies and separate saturation evidence are intentionally outside this collector; source and binary identities and prior complete archives are retained or referenced.
